cases.note: Type confusion caught by per-relationship scoring

rq1.note: Synthetic oracle agreement measures reconstruction fidelity vs generator declarations, not production validity.

rq2.intervention_reference_status: intervention_participation_mass.v1 available via evaluate_intervention_attribution; undefined on clean traces without interventions.
rq2.reference_disclosure: Primary scored reference equal_root_ancestor_mass.v1 is structurally aligned with ConservedRPA alpha=0. Zero MAE is NOT independent attribution accuracy. B2_p1_equal_share is an alias of RPA-P1. B3 Markov is not independently implemented.

rq3.interpretation_note: Negative mean Δ favors P2 (lower MAE). Phase 2.9 corpus often has DEPENDS_ON covering artifact paths → bridge subgroup may be empty; see experimental_2_13_bridges for distinguishable P1/P2 graphs. Do not claim P2 superiority without bridge-eligible evidence.
rq3.reference_limitation: MAE vs equal_root reference is non-discriminative for RPA α=0 alignment.

rq4.caveat: RQ4 does not establish comprehensive fault detection. It reports diagnostic signals under declared observability classes.

observability_aware.note: not_reliably_detectable faults are excluded from ordinary Assurance false-negative denominators. requires_ground_truth faults are reported separately and are not counted as ordinary online false negatives.

rq5.threat_model: tamper-evident relative to honestly retained checkpoint; NOT immutability; NOT external anchoring; NOT dual-rewrite resistant
